title: Katamino Challenge Dataset
description: Contract for the static, build-time-generated dataset of the 500 Katamino challenges bundled with the app (FR-001, FR-002). Produced by scripts/generate-challenges and consumed read-only at runtime.

version.description: Bump on any breaking change to challenge shape; consumers must reject unknown versions rather than guess.

id.description: Stable, unique identifier. Order of the array is not significant; id is the addressable key.

boardRows.description: Fixed per research.md §9 (matches the physical Katamino tray height).

boardCols.description: Equals requiredPieces.length. Starts at 3, not 2: no pair of distinct pentominoes tiles a 5x2 rectangle (verified empirically by the generator).

requiredPieces.description: Exact multiset of pentomino piece types required to fill the board; duplicates within a challenge are not allowed (each of the 12 pieces exists once in a physical Katamino set).

difficulty.description: Ordinal indicator for browsing/sorting only (Challenge.difficulty); not used by solvers or win-condition checks.

x-invariants: requiredPieces has no duplicate piece types within one challenge
every challenge is solvable by both solving strategies (verified by scripts/generate-challenges as an automated test, covering FR-014 / SC-002)
all 500 ids are present and unique
